#====项目纲要====
#【部署】Python 3.11+ 库与命令行工具，使用 Flit 构建；pip 安装后提供 sphinx-build、sphinx-quickstart、sphinx-apidoc、sphinx-autogen；开发检查以 tox/pytest、ruff、mypy 及 npm/Jasmine 为主，文档用 sphinx-build -M html ./doc ./build/sphinx --fail-on-warning 构建
#【系统】Sphinx 是以 Docutils 文档树为中间表示、由可扩展 Python 应用协调配置、解析、环境缓存、交叉引用、构建器与写出器，生成 HTML/LaTeX/EPUB/文本等格式的文档生成系统 | CLI→Sphinx 应用→配置/注册表/事件→BuildEnvironment→Builder/Transforms→Writer/模板与静态资产 | 必须保持扩展 API、事件生命周期、配置兼容、增量环境与各输出格式的公开契约
#【架构】入口层解析命令及构建模式；核心层由 application/config/events/registry/project/environment 协调；解析与领域层把 reStructuredText 及扩展语法转为 Docutils/Sphinx 节点并解析引用；构建器与写出器按目标格式处理节点；扩展层通过 setup(app) 注册事件、指令、角色、领域、构建器和资源；主题/模板/搜索/本地化提供展示与语言资源；testing 与 tests 提供集成夹具及契约验证
#【数据流】命令行参数与 conf.py→Config/Tags/扩展装载→Project 发现源文件→BuildEnvironment 读取并缓存 doctree/索引/依赖→Transforms 与引用解析→Builder 选择待写文档并调用 Writer/模板→目标目录；异常与警告经日志、事件和 CLI 状态码反馈
#【顶层约束】源码目录与输出目录不得相同；扩展依赖必须经应用注册机制装载；构建失败会移除环境缓存以强制后续全量环境；并行读取/写出仅在全部扩展明确声明安全时启用；新增行为需相应测试和文档，非平凡或行为变更需更新 CHANGES.rst；翻译源 .po 更新后须同步编译 .mo 与 .js
#【整体规范】
#纲要格式：文件名[标签]: Role:职责 | Uses:依赖 | API:对外契约 | Constraints:约束 ；文件名不带路径；四字段必填,无内容写-
#骨架规则：只有裸文件名没有纲要的行是尚未建立认知的文件,读取时顺便生成纲要并调用 ortg_update 提交
#目标规则：条目下一行 #目标: 是目标纲要(改完后应有的纲要,不写待核查事项)；#目标:删除 计划删除；#计划新建 文件尚不存在
#测试契约规则：被测试锁定的对外行为写成"必须保持 X(测试名)"并写清期望结果；只涉及一个文件的写进它的 Constraints,跨模块的登记进【契约】；需求与守护测试冲突时按证据裁决:需求点名该测试或说旧行为错→改测试,需求说测试权威/行为不变/只是迁移→保持,有命令与期望输出的验收例→按实跑结果,都没有→先求两全,不能两全按需求实现,并把选择与理由记进纲要
#契约规则：跨模块、不靠调用关系的约定(同一概念由多层共同实现、协议与消息格式、单位、兼容性、HTTP/WebSocket 路由与消息类型、配置键)在纲要头登记一行 #【契约】键：正文(正文写约定与守护测试,只写这一处)；每个参与文件在纲要行末尾加 | Keys:键(角色),… 声明它；路由、消息、事件、配置、环境变量类的键写成 route:/ws:/msg:/event:/topic:/cfg:/env: 加字面值
#===代码纲要规范===
#【标签】[C A B D… E] 重要度数字在前,其后层级、模块、特征(0到多个)、规模,空格分隔,每个是一个大写字母(模块可两个)
#A层级: E入口 C核心 S服务 D数据 I集成 U工具 T测试 B构建 X配置 O文档
#B模块: G核心通用 B构建写出 D领域语法 X扩展 H网页主题搜索 L本地化 T测试夹具 P项目文档 U开发工具
#C重要度: 9核心 8高频 7业务 5常规 3辅助 1边缘
#D特征: E事件扩展 I国际化 J模板前端 P并行缓存 V版本兼容
#E规模: L大>400 M中200-400 S小100-200 T微<100
#Constraints配额: C9≤2000字 C8≤1200字 C7-4≤500字 C3-1≤100字
#===代码纲要规范完毕===

name: Create release

on:
  push:
    tags:
    - "v*.*.*"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.head_ref || github.run_id }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  FORCE_COLOR: "1"
  UV_SYSTEM_PYTHON: "1"  # make uv do global installs

jobs:
  publish-pypi:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: PyPI Release
    environment: release
    if: github.repository_owner == 'sphinx-doc'
    permissions:
      attestations: write  # for actions/attest
      id-token: write  # for actions/attest & PyPI trusted publishing
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3"
      - name: Install uv
        uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
        with:
          version: latest
          enable-cache: false

      - name: Install build dependencies (pypa/build, twine)
        run: uv pip install --group package

      - name: Build distribution
        run: python -m build

      - name: Check distribution
        run: twine check dist/*

      - name: Create Sigstore attestations for built distributions
        uses: actions/attest@v1
        id: attest
        with:
          subject-path: "dist/*"
          predicate-type: "https://docs.pypi.org/attestations/publish/v1"
          predicate: "null"
          show-summary: "true"

      - name: Convert attestations to PEP 740
        run: >
          python utils/convert_attestations.py
          "$BUNDLE_PATH"
          "$SIGNER_IDENTITY"
        env:
          BUNDLE_PATH: "${{ steps.attest.outputs.bundle-path }}"
          # workflow_ref example: sphinx-doc/sphinx/.github/workflows/create-release.yml@refs/heads/master
          # this forms the "signer identity" for the attestations
          SIGNER_IDENTITY: "https://github.com/${{ github.workflow_ref }}"

      - name: Inspect PEP 740 attestations
        run: pypi-attestations inspect dist/*.publish.attestation

      - name: Prepare attestation bundles for uploading
        run: |
          mkdir -p /tmp/attestation-bundles
          cp "$BUNDLE_PATH" /tmp/attestation-bundles/
          cp dist/*.publish.attestation /tmp/attestation-bundles/
        env:
          BUNDLE_PATH: "${{ steps.attest.outputs.bundle-path }}"

      - name: Upload attestation bundles
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: attestation-bundles
          path: /tmp/attestation-bundles/

      - name: Upload to PyPI
        env:
          TWINE_NON_INTERACTIVE: "true"
        run: twine upload dist/* --attestations

  github-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    name: GitHub release
    environment: release
    if: github.repository_owner == 'sphinx-doc'
    permissions:
      contents: write  # for softprops/action-gh-release to create GitHub release
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v5
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - name: Get release version
        id: get_version
        uses: actions/github-script@v8
        with:
          script: core.setOutput('version', context.ref.replace("refs/tags/v", ""))

      - name: Create GitHub release
        uses: softprops/action-gh-release@v2
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/')
        with:
          name: "Sphinx ${{ steps.get_version.outputs.version }}"
          body: "Changelog: https://www.sphinx-doc.org/en/master/changes.html"

@@FILE .github/workflows/lock.yml
name: Lock old threads

on:
  schedule:
    # Run at midnight daily
    - cron: "0 0 * * *"
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  action:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.repository_owner == 'sphinx-doc'
    permissions:
      # to lock issues and PRs
      issues: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
    - uses: actions/github-script@v8
      with:
        retries: 3
        # language=JavaScript
        script: |
          const _FOUR_WEEKS_MILLISECONDS = 28 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000;
          const _FOUR_WEEKS_DATE = new Date(Date.now() - _FOUR_WEEKS_MILLISECONDS);
          const FOUR_WEEKS_AGO = `${_FOUR_WEEKS_DATE.toISOString().substring(0, 10)}T00:00:00Z`;
          const OWNER = context.repo.owner;
          const REPO = context.repo.repo;

          try {
            for (const thread_type of ["issue", "pr"]) {
              core.debug(`Finding ${thread_type}s to lock`);
              const query = thread_type === "issue"
                ? `repo:${OWNER}/${REPO} updated:<${FOUR_WEEKS_AGO} is:closed is:unlocked is:issue`
                : `repo:${OWNER}/${REPO} updated:<${FOUR_WEEKS_AGO} is:closed is:unlocked is:pr`;
              core.debug(`Using query '${query}'`);
              // https://octokit.github.io/rest.js/v21/#search-issues-and-pull-requests
              const {data: {items: results}} = await github.rest.search.issuesAndPullRequests({
                q: query,
                order: "desc",
                sort: "updated",
                per_page: 100,
              });
              for (const item of results) {
                if (item.locked) continue;
                const thread_num = item.number;
                core.debug(`Locking #${thread_num} (${thread_type})`);
                // https://octokit.github.io/rest.js/v21/#issues-lock
                await github.rest.issues.lock({
                  owner: OWNER,
                  repo: REPO,
                  issue_number: thread_num,
                  lock_reason: "resolved",
                });
              }
            }
          } catch (err) {
            core.setFailed(err.message);
          }

name: Synchronise translations

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - ".github/workflows/transifex.yml"
      - "utils/babel_runner.py"
  schedule:
  # 22:38 GMT, every Sunday. Chosen to be a random time.
  - cron: "38 22 * * SUN"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  FORCE_COLOR: "1"
  UV_SYSTEM_PYTHON: "1"  # make uv do global installs

jobs:
  push:
    if: github.repository_owner == 'sphinx-doc'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v6
      with:
        python-version: "3"
    - name: Install transifex client
      run: |
        mkdir -p /tmp/tx_cli && cd $_
        curl -o- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/transifex/cli/master/install.sh | bash
      shell: bash
    - name: Install uv
      uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
      with:
        version: latest
        enable-cache: false
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: uv pip install --group translations
    - name: Extract translations from source code
      run: python utils/babel_runner.py extract
    - name: Push translations to transifex.com
      run: |
        cd sphinx/locale
        /tmp/tx_cli/tx push --source --use-git-timestamps --workers 10
      env:
        TX_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TX_TOKEN }}

  pull:
    permissions:
      contents: write  # for peter-evans/create-pull-request to create branch
      pull-requests: write  # for peter-evans/create-pull-request to create a PR
    if: github.repository_owner == 'sphinx-doc'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v5
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
    - name: Set up Python
      uses: actions/setup-python@v6
      with:
        python-version: "3"
    - name: Install transifex client
      run: |
        mkdir -p /tmp/tx_cli && cd $_
        curl -o- https://raw.githubusercontent.com/transifex/cli/master/install.sh | bash
      shell: bash
    - name: Install uv
      uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@v6
      with:
        version: latest
        enable-cache: false
    - name: Install dependencies
      run: uv pip install --group translations
    - name: Extract translations from source code
      run: python utils/babel_runner.py extract
    - name: Pull translations from transifex.com
      run: |
        cd sphinx/locale
        /tmp/tx_cli/tx pull --translations --all --force --use-git-timestamps --workers 10
      env:
        TX_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.TX_TOKEN }}
    - name: Compile message catalogs
      run: python utils/babel_runner.py compile
    - name: Create Pull Request
      uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v7
      with:
        add-paths: |
          sphinx/locale
        commit-message: "[internationalisation] Update translations"
        branch: bot/pull-translations
        title: "[bot]: Update message catalogues"
        labels: "internals:internationalisation"
        body-path: babel_compile.txt

@@FILE Makefile
PYTHON ?= python3

.PHONY: all
all: format style-check type-check doclinter test

.PHONY: check
check: style-check type-check doclinter

.PHONY: clean
clean: clean
	# clean Python cache files:
	find . -name '*.pyc' -exec rm -f {} +
	find . -name '*.pyo' -exec rm -f {} +
	find . -name __pycache__ -exec rm -rf {} +

	# clean backup files:
	find . -name '*~' -exec rm -f {} +
	find . -name '*.bak' -exec rm -f {} +
	find . -name '*.swp' -exec rm -f {} +
	find . -name '*.swo' -exec rm -f {} +

	# clean generated:
	find . -name '.DS_Store' -exec rm -f {} +

	# clean rendered documentation:
	rm -rf doc/build/
	rm -rf doc/_build/
	rm -rf build/sphinx/

	# clean caches:
	find . -name '.mypy_cache' -exec rm -rf {} +
	find . -name '.ruff_cache' -exec rm -rf {} +

	# clean test files:
	rm -rf tests/.coverage
	rm -rf tests/build
	rm -rf .tox/
	rm -rf .cache/
	find . -name '.pytest_cache' -exec rm -rf {} +
	rm -f tests/test-server.lock

	# clean build files:
	rm -rf dist/
	rm -rf build/

.PHONY: style-check
style-check:
	@echo '[+] running ruff' ; ruff check .

.PHONY: format
format:
	@ruff format .

.PHONY: type-check
type-check:
	@mypy

.PHONY: doclinter
doclinter:
	@sphinx-lint --enable all --disable triple-backticks --max-line-length 85 --sort-by filename,line \
			     $(addprefix -i doc/, _build _static _templates _themes) \
	             AUTHORS.rst CHANGES.rst CODE_OF_CONDUCT.rst CONTRIBUTING.rst README.rst doc/

.PHONY: test
test:
	@$(PYTHON) -X dev -X warn_default_encoding -m pytest -v $(TEST)

.PHONY: covertest
covertest:
	@$(PYTHON) -X dev -X warn_default_encoding -m pytest -v --cov=sphinx --junitxml=.junit.xml $(TEST)

.PHONY: build
build:
	@$(PYTHON) -m build .

.PHONY: docs
docs:
ifndef target
	$(info You need to provide a target variable, e.g. `make docs target=html`.)
endif
	$(MAKE) -C doc $(target)

"""Run babel for translations.

Usage:

babel_runner.py extract
    Extract messages from the source code and update the ".pot" template file.

babel_runner.py update
    Update all language catalogues in "sphinx/locale/<language>/LC_MESSAGES"
    with the current messages in the template file.

babel_runner.py compile
    Compile the ".po" catalogue files to ".mo" and ".js" files.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import logging
import sys
import tempfile
from os import environ
from pathlib import Path

from babel.messages.catalog import Catalog
from babel.messages.extract import (
    DEFAULT_KEYWORDS,
    extract,
    extract_javascript,
    extract_python,
)
from babel.messages.mofile import write_mo
from babel.messages.pofile import read_po, write_po
from babel.util import pathmatch
from jinja2.ext import babel_extract as extract_jinja2

IS_CI = 'CI' in environ
ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
TEX_DELIMITERS = {
    'variable_start_string': '<%=',
    'variable_end_string': '%>',
    'block_start_string': '<%',
    'block_end_string': '%>',
}
METHOD_MAP = [
    # Extraction from Python source files
    ('**.py', extract_python),
    # Extraction from Jinja2 template files
    ('**/templates/latex/**.tex.jinja', extract_jinja2),
    ('**/templates/latex/**.tex_t', extract_jinja2),
    ('**/templates/latex/**.sty.jinja', extract_jinja2),
    ('**/templates/latex/**.sty_t', extract_jinja2),
    # Extraction from Jinja2 HTML templates
    ('**/themes/**.html', extract_jinja2),
    # Extraction from Jinja2 XML templates
    ('**/themes/**.xml', extract_jinja2),
    # Extraction from JavaScript files
    ('**.js', extract_javascript),
    ('**.js.jinja', extract_javascript),
    ('**.js_t', extract_javascript),
]
OPTIONS_MAP = {
    # Extraction from Python source files
    '**.py': {
        'encoding': 'utf-8',
    },
    # Extraction from Jinja2 template files
    '**/templates/latex/**.tex.jinja': TEX_DELIMITERS.copy(),
    '**/templates/latex/**.tex_t': TEX_DELIMITERS.copy(),
    '**/templates/latex/**.sty.jinja': TEX_DELIMITERS.copy(),
    '**/templates/latex/**.sty_t': TEX_DELIMITERS.copy(),
    # Extraction from Jinja2 HTML templates
    '**/themes/**.html': {
        'encoding': 'utf-8',
        'ignore_tags': 'script,style',
        'include_attrs': 'alt title summary',
    },
}
KEYWORDS = {**DEFAULT_KEYWORDS, '_': None, '__': None}


def run_extract() -> None:
    """Message extraction function."""
    log = _get_logger()

    with open('sphinx/__init__.py', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        lines = f.readlines()
    for line in lines:
        if line.startswith('__version__: Final = '):
            # remove prefix; strip whitespace; remove quotation marks
            sphinx_version = line[21:].strip()[1:-1]
            break

    catalogue = Catalog(project='Sphinx', version=sphinx_version, charset='utf-8')

    base = ROOT / 'sphinx'
    for filename in base.rglob('*'):
        relative_name = filename.relative_to(base)
        for pattern, method in METHOD_MAP:
            if not pathmatch(pattern, str(relative_name)):
                continue

            options = {}
            for opt_pattern, opt_dict in OPTIONS_MAP.items():
                if pathmatch(opt_pattern, str(relative_name)):
                    options = opt_dict
            with open(filename, 'rb') as fileobj:
                for lineno, message, comments, context in extract(
                    method,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
                    fileobj,
                    KEYWORDS,
                    options=options,
                ):
                    catalogue.add(
                        message,
                        None,
                        [(str(relative_name), lineno)],
                        auto_comments=comments,
                        context=context,
                    )
            break

    output_file = ROOT / 'sphinx' / 'locale' / 'sphinx.pot'
    log.info('writing PO template file to %s', output_file.relative_to(ROOT))
    with open(output_file, 'wb') as outfile:
        write_po(outfile, catalogue)


def run_update() -> None:
    """Catalog merging command."""
    log = _get_logger()

    domain = 'sphinx'
    locale_dir = ROOT / 'sphinx' / 'locale'
    template_file = locale_dir / 'sphinx.pot'

    with open(template_file, encoding='utf-8') as infile:
        template = read_po(infile)

    for locale in locale_dir.iterdir():
        filename = locale / 'LC_MESSAGES' / f'{domain}.po'
        if not filename.exists():
            continue

        log.info(
            'updating catalogue %s based on %s',
            filename.relative_to(ROOT),
            template_file.relative_to(ROOT),
        )
        with open(filename, encoding='utf-8') as infile:
            catalogue = read_po(infile, locale=locale.name, domain=domain)

        catalogue.update(template)
        tmp_name = filename.parent / (tempfile.gettempprefix() + filename.name)
        try:
            with open(tmp_name, 'wb') as tmpfile:
                write_po(tmpfile, catalogue)
        except Exception:
            tmp_name.unlink()
            raise

        tmp_name.replace(filename)


def run_compile() -> None:
    """Catalogue compilation command.

    An extended command that writes all message strings that occur in
    JavaScript files to a JavaScript file along with the .mo file.

    Unfortunately, babel's setup command isn't built very extensible, so
    most of the run() code is duplicated here.
    """
    log = _get_logger()

    directory = ROOT / 'sphinx' / 'locale'
    total_errors = {}

    for locale in directory.iterdir():
        po_file = locale / 'LC_MESSAGES' / 'sphinx.po'
        if not po_file.exists():
            continue

        with open(po_file, encoding='utf-8') as infile:
            catalogue = read_po(infile, locale=locale.name)

        if catalogue.fuzzy:
            log.info(
                'catalogue %s is marked as fuzzy, skipping', po_file.relative_to(ROOT)
            )
            continue

        locale_errors = 0
        for message, errors in catalogue.check():
            for error in errors:
                locale_errors += 1
                log.error(
                    'error: %s:%d: %s\nerror:     in message string: %r',
                    po_file.relative_to(ROOT),
                    message.lineno,
                    error,
                    message.string,
                )

        if locale_errors:
            total_errors[locale.name] = locale_errors
            log.info(
                '%d errors encountered in %r locale, skipping',
                locale_errors,
                locale.name,
            )
            continue

        mo_file = locale / 'LC_MESSAGES' / 'sphinx.mo'
        log.info(
            'compiling catalogue %s to %s',
            po_file.relative_to(ROOT),
            mo_file.relative_to(ROOT),
        )
        with open(mo_file, 'wb') as outfile:
            write_mo(outfile, catalogue, use_fuzzy=False)

        js_file = locale / 'LC_MESSAGES' / 'sphinx.js'
        log.info(
            'writing JavaScript strings in catalogue %s to %s',
            po_file.relative_to(ROOT),
            js_file.relative_to(ROOT),
        )
        js_catalogue = {}
        for message in catalogue:
            if any(
                x[0].endswith(('.js', '.js.jinja', '.js_t', '.html'))
                for x in message.locations
            ):
                msgid = message.id
                if isinstance(msgid, (list, tuple)):
                    msgid = msgid[0]
                js_catalogue[msgid] = message.string

        obj = json.dumps(
            {
                'messages': js_catalogue,
                'plural_expr': catalogue.plural_expr,
                'locale': str(catalogue.locale),
            },
            sort_keys=True,
            indent=4,
        )
        with open(js_file, 'wb') as outfile:
            # to ensure lines end with ``\n`` rather than ``\r\n``:
            outfile.write(f'Documentation.addTranslations({obj});'.encode())

    if total_errors:
        _write_pr_body_line('## Babel catalogue errors')
        _write_pr_body_line('')
        for locale_name, err_count in total_errors.items():
            log.error(
                'error: %d errors encountered in %r locale.', err_count, locale_name
            )
            s = 's' if err_count != 1 else ''
            _write_pr_body_line(f'* {locale_name}: {err_count} error{s}')


def _get_logger() -> logging.Logger:
    log = logging.getLogger('babel')
    log.setLevel(logging.INFO)
    handler = logging.StreamHandler()
    handler.setFormatter(logging.Formatter('%(message)s'))
    log.addHandler(handler)
    return log


def _write_pr_body_line(message: str) -> None:
    if not IS_CI:
        return
    with open('babel_compile.txt', 'a', encoding='utf-8') as f:
        f.write(f'{message}\n')


if __name__ == '__main__':
    try:
        action = sys.argv[1].lower()
    except IndexError:
        print(__doc__, file=sys.stderr)
        raise SystemExit(2) from None

    if action == 'extract':
        run_extract()
    elif action == 'update':
        run_update()
    elif action == 'compile':
        run_compile()
    elif action == 'all':
        run_extract()
        run_update()
        run_compile()
    else:
        msg = f"invalid action: '{action}'"
        raise ValueError(msg)
    raise SystemExit

"""Convert Sigstore attestations to PEP 740.

See https://github.com/trailofbits/pypi-attestations.
"""

# resolution fails without betterproto and protobuf-specs
# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.11"
# dependencies = [
#     "pypi-attestations==0.0.27",
#     "betterproto==2.0.0b6",
# ]
# ///

from __future__ import annotations

import json
import sys
from base64 import b64decode
from pathlib import Path

from pypi_attestations import Attestation, Distribution
from sigstore.models import Bundle
from sigstore.verify.policy import Identity

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
DIST = ROOT / 'dist'
bundle_path = Path(sys.argv[1])
signer_identity = sys.argv[2]

for line in bundle_path.read_bytes().splitlines():
    dsse_envelope_payload = json.loads(line)['dsseEnvelope']['payload']
    subjects = json.loads(b64decode(dsse_envelope_payload))['subject']
    for subject in subjects:
        filename = subject['name']
        assert (DIST / filename).is_file()

        # Convert attestation from Sigstore to PEP 740
        print(f'Converting attestation for {filename}')
        sigstore_bundle = Bundle.from_json(line)
        attestation = Attestation.from_bundle(sigstore_bundle)
        attestation_path = DIST / f'{filename}.publish.attestation'
        attestation_path.write_text(attestation.model_dump_json())
        print(f'Attestation for {filename} written to {attestation_path}')
        print()

        # Validate attestation
        dist = Distribution.from_file(DIST / filename)
        attestation = Attestation.model_validate_json(attestation_path.read_bytes())
        identity = Identity(identity=signer_identity)
        attestation.verify(identity=identity, dist=dist)
        print(f'Verified {attestation_path}')

**Planning to prioritize missing core domain code**
**Planning full read of python domain module**
本批 28 条已原子提交并对齐。顶层配置完成后，剩余缺口中仍有领域核心源码；为保持阶段顺序，我先回到 `domains` 核心，读取现有 D 模块纲要作为依赖背景，再分文件全文核读 Python 领域实现，不会触碰源码。另有一条工具标签出现非阻断告警，我会在后续元数据批次中改为无歧义的入口层标签。

content.text:
#代码纲要

===/testbed/doc/extdev/===
domainapi.rst[8 O D E M]: Role:公开自定义领域、对象类型、索引、对象描述指令及 Python 领域对象注册 API | Uses:sphinx/domains/__init__.py(Domain/ObjType/Index), sphinx/directives/__init__.py(ObjectDescription), sphinx/domains/python/__init__.py(PythonDomain) | API:Domain、ObjType、Index、IndexEntry、ObjectDescription、PythonDomain | Constraints:ObjectDescription 的 _toc_entry_name 与 _object_hierarchy_parts 属于供扩展覆盖的私有命名钩子；领域对象和模块应通过领域记录方法维护
markupapi.rst[8 O D E V L]: Role:定义扩展实现和注册 reStructuredText 角色、指令及嵌套/内联内容解析的 Docutils/Sphinx 接口 | Uses:sphinx/util/docutils.py(SphinxRole/ReferenceRole/SphinxDirective), sphinx/util/parsing.py(嵌套解析), sphinx/util/nodes.py(旧版带标题解析), sphinx/application.py(角色指令注册) | API:SphinxRole、ReferenceRole、SphinxDirective；角色函数与 Directive.run 契约 | Constraints:角色返回节点列表与系统消息列表二元组；指令 run 返回插入 doctree 的节点列表，参数/选项/内容由类属性声明；parse_inline 仅可处理无结构元素的单行或段落；生成可解析内容须保留 ViewList/StringList 的源文件和行号信息；switch_source_input 用于混合来源诊断
nodes.rst[8 O D V M]: Role:列出 Sphinx 为对象签名、交叉引用、目录、版本说明和特殊结构增加的 doctree 节点类型 | Uses:sphinx/addnodes.py(节点定义), sphinx/transforms/post_transforms/__init__.py(签名回退转换) | API:sphinx.addnodes 中列出的 desc_*、versionmodified、seealso、pending_xref、only、toctree 等节点；SIG_ELEMENTS | Constraints:自定义签名元素应继承 desc_sig_element 并以 _sig_element=True 注册，直接修改 SIG_ELEMENTS 仅为向后兼容；glossary/toctree/start_of_file/production* 不应由扩展直接生成
parserapi.rst[7 O D E S]: Role:定义扩展注册源文件后缀与 Parser、通过文件类型匹配 Parser.supported 的解析器接入协议 | Uses:sphinx/parsers.py(Parser 基类), sphinx/application.py(add_source_suffix/add_source_parser), sphinx/config.py(source_suffix) | API:Parser 扩展基类；Sphinx.add_source_suffix、Sphinx.add_source_parser | Constraints:source_suffix 映射扩展名到文件类型，解析器必须在 supported 中声明所支持类型；用户配置可覆盖后缀映射，匹配按文件类型而非扩展名直接选解析器

===/testbed/doc/usage/===
markdown.rst[5 O D E T]: Role:说明通过 MyST-Parser 扩展让 Sphinx 解析 CommonMark/Markdown 文件并配置后缀映射 | Uses:sphinx/parsers.py(解析器协议), sphinx/config.py(source_suffix), doc/usage/configuration.rst(扩展和后缀配置) | API:- | Constraints:须安装并在 extensions 中启用 myst_parser；非 .md 后缀必须在 source_suffix 显式映射到 markdown；非 CommonMark 语法由 MyST 自身配置控制
referencing.rst[8 O D V L]: Role:定义 Sphinx 对对象、任意标签、文档、下载、编号对象、配置项、术语和任意目标的跨引用角色与修饰语法 | Uses:sphinx/roles.py(通用角色), sphinx/domains/std/__init__.py(标准目标), sphinx/addnodes.py(pending_xref), sphinx/ext/intersphinx/(外部解析), doc/usage/domains/(领域角色) | API:ref、doc、download、numref、confval、envvar、token、keyword、option、term、any 角色 | Constraints:! 前缀只保留样式不生成链接，~ 仅缩短显示文本且 HTML title 保留全名；ref 标签全库唯一、定义带前导下划线而引用省略，非标题/图表标签须显式链接文字；doc 路径大小写敏感；download 仅 HTML 复制到带唯一哈希目录；numfig 关闭时 numref 不生成编号链接；any 多匹配或无匹配会警告并在本地失败后查询 intersphinx

===/testbed/doc/usage/domains/===
c.rst[8 O D V L]: Role:定义 C 领域对变量、函数、宏、结构/联合/枚举、类型、别名、表达式和文档命名空间的描述与引用语法 | Uses:sphinx/domains/c/(C 解析与领域), sphinx/directives/__init__.py(对象描述), sphinx/config.py(C 签名配置) | API:c:member/var/function/macro/struct/union/enum/enumerator/type/alias/namespace/namespace-push/namespace-pop 指令；c:member/data/var/func/macro/struct/union/enum/enumerator/type/expr/texpr 角色 | Constraints:匿名实体文档名必须以 @ 开头且渲染为 [anonymous]，嵌套引用可省略匿名段；alias maxdepth=0 表示无限、noroot 要求 0 或至少 2；namespace 重置栈，push 相对追加，pop 撤销最近整次 push，无 push 时回全局；NULL/0 选全局；single-line-parameter-list 覆盖专属及全局行长
cpp.rst[8 O D V L]: Role:定义 C++ 领域对类、函数、变量、类型、枚举、概念、别名、表达式、模板与命名空间的解析、排版和精确引用规则 | Uses:sphinx/domains/cpp/(C++ 解析与领域), sphinx/directives/__init__.py(对象描述), sphinx/config.py(C++ 签名配置) | API:cpp:class/struct/function/member/var/type/enum/enum-struct/enum-class/enumerator/union/concept/alias/namespace/namespace-push/namespace-pop 指令；cpp:any/class/struct/func/member/var/type/concept/enum/enumerator/expr/texpr 角色 | Constraints:概念支持实验性且不支持 requires 子句；匿名实体用 @ 名并显示 [anonymous]；alias 裸函数名列出全部重载，完整声明锁定重载；namespace 的 pop 撤销最近整次 push，NULL/0/nullptr 回全局；模板引用中的 < 会被角色解释为标题分隔，须转义或使用 expr/texpr；部分特化引用必须含参数列表且参数标识符须逐字相同
index.rst[8 O D V L]: Role:解释领域如何封装对象指令、引用角色和索引，列出内置/第三方领域并规定通用对象描述选项与默认领域 | Uses:sphinx/domains/(领域实现), sphinx/directives/__init__.py(对象描述), sphinx/roles.py(引用), doc/extdev/domainapi.rst(扩展 API), doc/usage/referencing.rst(引用修饰) | API:内置 std、c、cpp、js、math、py、rst 领域；default-domain 指令 | Constraints:no-index-entry 仅抑制索引条目，no-contents-entry 仅排除目录，no-index 还禁用交叉引用并蕴含前者，no-typesetting 仅建目标/索引不渲染；旧无连字符选项是兼容别名；primary_domain 全局生效而 default-domain 仅余下当前文件；未设置时 py 为默认领域
javascript.rst[7 O D V M]: Role:定义 JavaScript 领域的模块、函数/方法、类、数据和属性描述及相应交叉引用角色 | Uses:sphinx/domains/javascript.py(JavaScript 领域), sphinx/directives/__init__.py(对象描述), sphinx/config.py(签名行长) | API:js:module、js:function、js:method、js:class、js:data、js:attribute 指令；js:mod/func/meth/class/data/attr 角色 | Constraints:js:module 设置后续对象上下文并默认建立模块索引目标，no-index 时只更新上下文；method 是 function 的方法语义别名；single-line-parameter-list 覆盖 JavaScript 专属和全局签名行长配置
mathematics.rst[5 O D T]: Role:定义 math 领域按 math 指令标签交叉引用带编号公式的角色 | Uses:sphinx/domains/math.py(公式领域), sphinx/directives/patches.py(math 指令) | API:math:numref 角色 | Constraints:引用目标必须是 math 指令的 label
python.rst[9 O D V L]: Role:定义 Python 领域对模块、函数、数据、异常、类、属性、属性方法、类型别名、方法和装饰器的签名、字段与交叉引用语法 | Uses:sphinx/domains/python/(Python 领域), sphinx/directives/__init__.py(对象描述), sphinx/util/docfields.py(信息字段), sphinx/config.py(Python 签名与引用配置), sphinx/ext/autodoc/(meta 字段消费者) | API:py:module/currentmodule/function/data/exception/class/attribute/property/type/method/staticmethod/classmethod/decorator/decoratormethod 指令；py:mod/func/deco/data/const/class/meth/attr/type/exc/obj 角色 | Constraints:currentmodule 仅改变上下文，不建模块目标/索引；成员优先嵌套在 class 中，外置时签名须含类名；type 指令选项须是有效 Python 注解表达式，不支持 reStructuredText 或 or/of，而信息字段 type 支持容器及 or/|；method 参数不含 self，decorator 签名按 @ 使用形式省略被装饰对象；canonical 指向真正定义位置；点前缀优先当前上下文并允许后缀匹配，歧义告警，可与 ~ 缩写显示组合
restructuredtext.rst[7 O D V S]: Role:定义 reStructuredText 领域对指令、指令选项和角色本身的描述及交叉引用标记 | Uses:sphinx/domains/rst.py(reStructuredText 领域), sphinx/directives/__init__.py(对象描述) | API:rst:directive、rst:directive:option、rst:role 指令；rst:dir、rst:role 角色 | Constraints:directive 名可写裸名或含 .. 与 :: 的完整语法；directive:option 以 directive:option 目标名建立隶属引用且 type 描述按文本呈现；rst:dir 同时引用指令和以 directive:option 形式命名的选项
standard.rst[7 O D V M]: Role:定义无前缀标准领域对命令选项、配置值、环境变量、程序上下文和通用描述对象的标记 | Uses:sphinx/domains/std/__init__.py(标准领域), sphinx/application.py(add_object_type), sphinx/config.py(选项占位强调) | API:option、confval、envvar、program、describe/object 指令及 option、confval、envvar 角色 | Constraints:option 可从包含值的写法解析同一选项目标；program 改变后续 option 命名空间，传 None 重置且程序名可含子命令空格；confval 的 type/default 按 reStructuredText 解析；describe/object 只排版，不建索引或交叉引用目标

===/testbed/doc/usage/restructuredtext/===
basics.rst[8 O D V L]: Role:介绍 Sphinx 默认 reStructuredText 的段落、内联标记、列表、代码、表格、链接、章节、指令、图像、引用、替换和元数据语法 | Uses:sphinx/parsers.py(reStructuredText 解析), sphinx/directives/(Sphinx 指令), sphinx/roles.py(Sphinx 角色), doc/usage/restructuredtext/directives.rst(扩展指令), doc/usage/restructuredtext/roles.rst(扩展角色) | API:- | Constraints:缩进决定结构且嵌套列表需空行；内联标记不可嵌套、边界不得空白并须与单词分隔；显式标记以 .. 开始并在同级段落结束，指令选项与内容缩进基线由最先出现者决定；不得使用 sectnum/header/footer；绝对 include 与图像路径相对源目录，图像通配扩展由构建器选最佳格式且文件名不应含空格；像素尺寸仅用于支持像素的输出，LaTeX 按 96px=1in；引用全项目可用；源文件只支持 UTF-8；meta keywords 按语言进入对应搜索索引
directives.rst[9 O D V L]: Role:定义 Sphinx 的跨文档目录、提示框、版本标记、代码包含、术语表、索引、条件内容、表格、数学与文法产生式指令 | Uses:sphinx/directives/(指令实现), sphinx/environment/collectors/toctree.py(目录关系), sphinx/domains/std/__init__.py(术语索引与产生式), sphinx/directives/code.py(代码包含), sphinx/directives/patches.py(数学与表格补丁) | API:toctree、seealso、version-added/versionadded、version-changed/versionchanged、version-deprecated/deprecated、version-removed/versionremoved、rubric、centered、hlist、highlight、code-block/sourcecode/code、literalinclude、glossary、sectionauthor、codeauthor、index、only、tabularcolumns、math、productionlist 指令；index 角色 | Constraints:所有源文档应在某个 toctree 中或标 orphan/exclude，root_doc 为层级根；numbered/includehidden 只放顶层目录，glob 按字母序且 ** 可跨斜杠；genindex/modindex/search 与下划线前缀名保留，HTML 文件名禁冒号、EPUB 禁加号；折叠提示框在不支持的格式始终展开；新版版本指令保留旧无连字符别名，说明与指令头之间不得空行；Pygments 失败时整块不高亮，稳定结果需锁定 Pygments；literalinclude 绝对路径相对源目录，lineno-match 仅连续选择，筛选后 emphasize-lines 从 1 重计，diff 生成统一差异；glossary 多术语共享定义且 key 大小写敏感；only 仅控制内容不能可靠控制章节或标签，构建器标准标签在读取配置后才添加；tabularcolumns 只影响下一张 LaTeX 表且压过 widths，含代码或嵌套表退回 tabular，超过 30 行用 longtable；Python docstring 数学反斜杠须双写或用 raw string；math no-wrap 由作者提供完整环境；productionlist 禁空行且续行冒号须同列
domains.rst[3 O D V S]: Role:为已迁移的领域文档保留旧 Python、C、C++、标准、JavaScript、reStructuredText 与数学标记锚点并重定向到新页面 | Uses:doc/usage/domains/index.rst(领域总览), doc/usage/domains/python.rst(Python), doc/usage/domains/c.rst(C), doc/usage/domains/cpp.rst(C++), doc/usage/domains/standard.rst(标准领域) | API:- | Constraints:原有 HTML 锚点必须保留以维持旧入站链接兼容，正文语义以各 usage/domains 页面为准
field-lists.rst[5 O D V T]: Role:定义文档开头字段列表转为环境元数据以及 tocdepth、评论、孤立页和搜索控制字段的语义 | Uses:sphinx/environment/collectors/metadata.py(元数据收集), sphinx/search/(全文搜索), sphinx/environment/adapters/toctree.py(目录深度) | API:tocdepth、nocomments、orphan、no-search 文档元数据字段 | Constraints:字段值解析为字符串而非 Python 集合；只有任何其他标记之前的字段列表转入环境且不显示，标题之后仍作为 docinfo 显示；tocdepth 只影响本地目录不影响全局侧栏；no-search 只禁全文搜索不禁对象搜索；nosearch 是保留兼容的旧别名
index.rst[3 O D T]: Role:组织 reStructuredText 用户指南并导航基础语法、角色、指令、字段列表与领域兼容页 | Uses:doc/usage/restructuredtext/basics.rst(基础), doc/usage/restructuredtext/roles.rst(角色), doc/usage/restructuredtext/directives.rst(指令), doc/usage/restructuredtext/field-lists.rst(字段), doc/usage/restructuredtext/domains.rst(旧锚点) | API:- | Constraints:领域兼容页隐藏于目录，主要指南目录最大深度两层
roles.rst[8 O D I L]: Role:定义 Sphinx 的交叉引用、内联代码、数学、语义排版、外部标准链接角色及内置替换变量 | Uses:sphinx/roles.py(通用角色实现), sphinx/domains/std/__init__.py(标准角色), sphinx/domains/math.py(公式引用), sphinx/config.py(默认角色与替换配置), doc/usage/referencing.rst(交叉引用规则) | API:code、math、eq、abbr、command、dfn、file、guilabel、kbd、mailheader、makevar、manpage、menuselection、mimetype、newsgroup、program、regexp、samp、index、cve、cwe、pep、rfc 角色；|release|、|version|、|today|、|translation progress| 替换 | Constraints:默认角色起初无语义，须用 default_role 指定；code 不继承 highlight 语言，语法高亮需先定义带 language 的派生角色，多行用 code-block；eq 等同 math:numref；abbr 括号解释在 HTML 为提示、LaTeX 仅输出一次；GUI/menu 的单 & 表快捷键、字面 & 写 &&；menuselection 层级用 -->；Windows program 名省略 .exe；file/samp 花括号标变量，samp 双反斜杠转义字面花括号；外部标准角色接受 #anchor；release 是完整版本而 version 只含主次版本

===/testbed/sphinx/===
addnodes.py[9 D D I L]: Role:定义 Sphinx 在 Docutils 文档树之上的目录、对象签名、索引、交叉引用、提示框及翻译节点类型并注册内置节点 | Uses:sphinx/application.py(节点注册) | API:translatable、toctree、desc 及 desc_* 签名节点、SIG_ELEMENTS、versionmodified、index、pending_xref、pending_xref_condition、number_reference、download_reference 等节点类；setup | Constraints:translatable 节点必须保留原始消息供最终 gettext 提取，翻译应用不得覆盖保存值；多行签名只能含 desc_signature_line；_sig_element=True 的子类才自动进入 SIG_ELEMENTS；pending_xref 条件节点只能独占其父节点子项，* 为失败回退、resolved 为建议成功条件。必须保持九个内置签名元素自动注册而普通或显式 false 子类不注册（test_desc_sig_element_nodes）
parsers.py[8 C D V S]: Role:定义附加源解析器基类和 Sphinx reStructuredText 解析器，在 Docutils 解析前后注入项目 prolog/epilog 并替换智能引号转换 | Uses:sphinx/config.py(rst_prolog/rst_epilog), sphinx/environment/__init__.py(解析环境), sphinx/util/rst.py(前后缀注入), sphinx/deprecation.py(旧解析器属性告警) | API:Parser、RSTParser、setup | Constraints:Parser.config/env/set_application 均为 Sphinx 9 弃用接口；RSTParser 从 Docutils 转换中移除 SmartQuotes；字符串输入按 tab_width 展开并转换空白，prolog 使用 <rst_prologue> 来源且与正文以生成空行分隔，epilog 追加在正文来源之后。必须保持 prolog、epilog、tab 与垂直空白的来源行映射（test_RSTParser_prolog_epilog）
roles.py[9 D D I L]: Role:实现 Sphinx 通用交叉引用、外部标准链接、语义文字、键盘、菜单、manpage 与统一代码高亮角色并注册到 Docutils | Uses:sphinx/addnodes.py(引用与索引节点), sphinx/environment/__init__.py(引用上下文与序号), sphinx/util/docutils.py(角色基类), sphinx/config.py(角色显示配置) | API:XRefRole、AnyXRefRole、CVE、CWE、PEP、RFC、GUILabel、MenuSelection、EmphasizedLiteral、Abbreviation、Keyboard、Manpage、code_role、setup | Constraints:XRefRole 的 ! 禁用形式生成非引用节点，显式标题不自动改括号，目标始终去函数括号并压缩空白；any 引用携带全部 ref_context 且失败须告警；CVE/CWE/PEP/RFC 同时产生索引目标与外链，无效数字产生 problematic；GUI 单 & 标快捷键、&& 为字面 &，菜单 --> 转三角分隔；file/samp 仅非空成对花括号强调且支持反斜杠转义；kbd 保留已知双词键；code 角色与 code-block 使用同类短 Pygments 类名。必须保持 samp 的空、半开、嵌套和转义花括号解析以及 RFC 已知 section/page/appendix 锚点的人类可读标题（tests/test_roles.py）

    def _pformat_token(self, tok: Token, native: bool = False) -> str:
        if native:
            return tok.value

        if tok.match(token.NEWLINE, token.ENDMARKER):
            return ''

        if tok.match([token.OP, ':'], [token.OP, ','], [token.OP, '#']):
            return f'{tok.value} '

        # Arithmetic operators are allowed because PEP 695 specifies the
        # default type parameter to be *any* expression (so "T1 << T2" is
        # allowed if it makes sense). The caller is responsible to ensure
        # that a multiplication operator ("*") is not to be confused with
        # an unpack operator (which will not be surrounded by spaces).
        #
        # The operators are ordered according to how likely they are to
        # be used and for (possible) future implementations (e.g., "&" for
        # an intersection type).
        if tok.match(
            # Most likely operators to appear
            [token.OP, '='], [token.OP, '|'],
            # Type composition (future compatibility)
            [token.OP, '&'], [token.OP, '^'], [token.OP, '<'], [token.OP, '>'],
            # Unlikely type composition
            [token.OP, '+'], [token.OP, '-'], [token.OP, '*'], [token.OP, '**'],
            # Unlikely operators but included for completeness

def _parse_type_list(
    tp_list: str,
    env: BuildEnvironment,
    multi_line_parameter_list: bool = False,
    trailing_comma: bool = True,
) -> addnodes.desc_type_parameter_list:
    """Parse a list of type parameters according to PEP 695."""
    type_params = addnodes.desc_type_parameter_list(tp_list)
    type_params['multi_line_parameter_list'] = multi_line_parameter_list
    type_params['multi_line_trailing_comma'] = trailing_comma
    # formal parameter names are interpreted as type parameter names and
    # type annotations are interpreted as type parameter bound or constraints
    parser = _TypeParameterListParser(tp_list)
    parser.parse()
    for tp_name, tp_kind, tp_default, tp_ann in parser.type_params:
        # no positional-only or keyword-only allowed in a type parameters list
        if tp_kind in {Parameter.POSITIONAL_ONLY, Parameter.KEYWORD_ONLY}:
            msg = (
                'positional-only or keyword-only parameters '
                'are prohibited in type parameter lists'
            )
            raise SyntaxError(msg)

        node = addnodes.desc_type_parameter()
        if tp_kind == Parameter.VAR_POSITIONAL:
            node += addnodes.desc_sig_operator('', '*')
        elif tp_kind == Parameter.VAR_KEYWORD:
            node += addnodes.desc_sig_operator('', '**')
        node += addnodes.desc_sig_name('', tp_name)

        if tp_ann is not Parameter.empty:
            annotation = _parse_annotation(tp_ann, env)
            if not annotation:
                continue

            node += addnodes.desc_sig_punctuation('', ':')
            node += addnodes.desc_sig_space()

            type_ann_expr = addnodes.desc_sig_name('', '', *annotation)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
            # a type bound is ``T: U`` whereas type constraints
            # must be enclosed with parentheses. ``T: (U, V)``
            if tp_ann.startswith('(') and tp_ann.endswith(')'):
                type_ann_text = type_ann_expr.astext()
                if type_ann_text.startswith('(') and type_ann_text.endswith(')'):
                    node += type_ann_expr
                else:
                    # surrounding braces are lost when using _parse_annotation()
                    node += addnodes.desc_sig_punctuation('', '(')
                    node += type_ann_expr  # type constraint
                    node += addnodes.desc_sig_punctuation('', ')')
            else:
                node += type_ann_expr  # type bound

        if tp_default is not Parameter.empty:
            # Always surround '=' with spaces, even if there is no annotation
            node += addnodes.desc_sig_space()
            node += addnodes.desc_sig_operator('', '=')
            node += addnodes.desc_sig_space()
            node += nodes.inline(
                '', tp_default, classes=['default_value'], support_smartquotes=False
            )

        type_params += node
    return type_params


def _parse_arglist(
    arglist: str,
    env: BuildEnvironment,
    multi_line_parameter_list: bool = False,
    trailing_comma: bool = True,
) -> addnodes.desc_parameterlist:
    """Parse a list of arguments using AST parser"""
    params = addnodes.desc_parameterlist(arglist)
    params['multi_line_parameter_list'] = multi_line_parameter_list
    params['multi_line_trailing_comma'] = trailing_comma
    sig = signature_from_str('(%s)' % arglist)
    last_kind = None
    for param in sig.parameters.values():
        if param.kind != param.POSITIONAL_ONLY and last_kind == param.POSITIONAL_ONLY:
            params += _positional_only_separator()
        if param.kind == param.KEYWORD_ONLY and last_kind in {
            param.POSITIONAL_OR_KEYWORD,
            param.POSITIONAL_ONLY,
            None,
        }:
            params += _keyword_only_separator()

        node = addnodes.desc_parameter()
        if param.kind == param.VAR_POSITIONAL:
            node += addnodes.desc_sig_operator('', '*')
            node += addnodes.desc_sig_name('', param.name)
        elif param.kind == param.VAR_KEYWORD:
            node += addnodes.desc_sig_operator('', '**')
            node += addnodes.desc_sig_name('', param.name)
        else:
            node += addnodes.desc_sig_name('', param.name)

        if param.annotation is not param.empty:
            children = _parse_annotation(param.annotation, env)
            node += addnodes.desc_sig_punctuation('', ':')
            node += addnodes.desc_sig_space()
            node += addnodes.desc_sig_name('', '', *children)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
        if param.default is not param.empty:
            if param.annotation is not param.empty:
                node += addnodes.desc_sig_space()
                node += addnodes.desc_sig_operator('', '=')
                node += addnodes.desc_sig_space()
            else:
                node += addnodes.desc_sig_operator('', '=')
            node += nodes.inline(
                '', param.default, classes=['default_value'], support_smartquotes=False
            )

        params += node
        last_kind = param.kind

    if last_kind == Parameter.POSITIONAL_ONLY:
        params += _positional_only_separator()

    return params


def _positional_only_separator() -> addnodes.desc_parameter:
    # PEP 570: Separator for positional only parameters: /
    positional_only_abbr = nodes.abbreviation(
        '/', '/', explanation=_('Positional-only parameter separator (PEP 570)')
    )
    positional_only_op = addnodes.desc_sig_operator(
        '/', '', positional_only_abbr, classes=['positional-only-separator']
    )
    return addnodes.desc_parameter('/', '', positional_only_op)


def _keyword_only_separator() -> addnodes.desc_parameter:
    # PEP 3102: Separator for keyword only parameters: *
    keyword_only_abbr = nodes.abbreviation(
        '*', '*', explanation=_('Keyword-only parameters separator (PEP 3102)')
    )
    keyword_only_op = addnodes.desc_sig_operator(
        '*', '', keyword_only_abbr, classes=['keyword-only-separator']
    )
    return addnodes.desc_parameter('*', '', keyword_only_op)


def _pseudo_parse_arglist(
    signode: desc_signature,
    arglist: str,
    *,
    multi_line_parameter_list: bool = False,
    trailing_comma: bool = True,
    env: BuildEnvironment,
) -> None:
    """'Parse' a list of arguments separated by commas.

    Arguments can have "optional" annotations given by enclosing them in
    brackets.  Currently, this will split at any comma, even if it's inside a
    string literal (e.g. default argument value).
    """
    # TODO: decompose 'env' parameter into only the required bits
    paramlist = addnodes.desc_parameterlist()
    paramlist['multi_line_parameter_list'] = multi_line_parameter_list
    paramlist['multi_line_trailing_comma'] = trailing_comma
    stack: list[Element] = [paramlist]
    try:
        for argument in arglist.split(','):
            argument = argument.strip()
            ends_open = ends_close = 0
            while argument.startswith('['):
                stack.append(addnodes.desc_optional())
                stack[-2] += stack[-1]
                argument = argument[1:].strip()
            while argument.startswith(']'):
                stack.pop()
                argument = argument[1:].strip()
            while argument.endswith(']') and not argument.endswith('[]'):
                ends_close += 1
                argument = argument[:-1].strip()
            while argument.endswith('['):
                ends_open += 1
                argument = argument[:-1].strip()
            if argument:

def test_domain_py_python_trailing_comma_in_multi_line_signatures_in_text(app):
    app.build()
    content = (app.outdir / 'index.txt').read_text(encoding='utf8')
    param_line_fmt = STDINDENT * ' ' + '{}\n'

    expected_parameter_list_hello = '(\n{}) -> str'.format(

    assert expected_parameter_list_hello in content

    expected_a = param_line_fmt.format('[a,[')

    expected_b = param_line_fmt.format('b,]]')
    assert expected_b in content

    expected_c = param_line_fmt.format('c,')
    assert expected_c in content

    expected_d = param_line_fmt.format('d[,')
    assert expected_d in content

    expected_e = param_line_fmt.format('e,')
    assert expected_e in content

    expected_f = param_line_fmt.format('f]')
    assert expected_f in content

    expected_parameter_list_foo = '(\n{}{}{}{}{}{})'.format(
        expected_a,
        expected_b,
        expected_c,
        expected_d,
        expected_e,
        expected_f,
    )
    assert expected_parameter_list_foo in content

import re
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING

from docutils import nodes
from docutils.parsers.rst import directives

from sphinx import addnodes
from sphinx.addnodes import pending_xref, pending_xref_condition
from sphinx.directives import ObjectDescription
from sphinx.domains.python._annotations import (
    _parse_annotation,
    _parse_arglist,
    _parse_type_list,
    _pseudo_parse_arglist,
    parse_reftarget,

)

    from typing import ClassVar

    from docutils.parsers.rst.states import Inliner

    from sphinx.addnodes import desc_signature
    from sphinx.environment import BuildEnvironment
    from sphinx.util.typing import OptionSpec, TextlikeNode

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)

# REs for Python signatures
py_sig_re = re.compile(
    r"""^ ([\w.]*\.)?            # class name(s)
          (\w+)  \s*             # thing name
          (?: \[\s*(.*?)\s*])?   # optional: type parameters list
          (?: \(\s*(.*)\s*\)     # optional: arguments
           (?:\s* -> \s* (.*))?  #           return annotation
          )? $                   # and nothing more
      """,
    re.VERBOSE,
)


# This override allows our inline type specifiers to behave like :class: link
# when it comes to handling "." and "~" prefixes.
class PyXrefMixin:
    def make_xref(
        self,
        rolename: str,
        domain: str,
        target: str,
        innernode: type[TextlikeNode] = nodes.emphasis,
        contnode: Node | None = None,
        env: BuildEnvironment | None = None,
        inliner: Inliner | None = None,
        location: Node | None = None,
    ) -> Node:
        # we use inliner=None to make sure we get the old behaviour with a single
        # pending_xref node
        result = super().make_xref(  # type: ignore[misc]
            rolename,
            domain,
            target,
            innernode,
            contnode,
            env,
            inliner=None,
            location=None,
        )
        if isinstance(result, pending_xref):
            assert env is not None
            result['refspecific'] = True
            result['py:module'] = env.ref_context.get('py:module')
            result['py:class'] = env.ref_context.get('py:class')

            reftype, reftarget, reftitle, _ = parse_reftarget(target)
            if reftarget != reftitle:
                result['reftype'] = reftype
                result['reftarget'] = reftarget

                result.clear()
                result += innernode(reftitle, reftitle)  # type: ignore[call-arg]
            elif env.config.python_use_unqualified_type_names:
                children = result.children
                result.clear()

                shortname = target.rpartition('.')[-1]
                textnode = innernode('', shortname)  # type: ignore[call-arg]
                contnodes = [
                    pending_xref_condition('', '', textnode, condition='resolved'),
                    pending_xref_condition('', '', *children, condition='*'),
                ]
                result.extend(contnodes)

        return result

    _delimiters_re = re.compile(
        r'(\s*[\[\]\(\),](?:\s*o[rf]\s)?\s*|\s+o[rf]\s+|\s*\|\s*|\.\.\.)'
    )

    def make_xrefs(
        self,
        rolename: str,
        domain: str,
        target: str,
        innernode: type[TextlikeNode] = nodes.emphasis,
        contnode: Node | None = None,
        env: BuildEnvironment | None = None,
        inliner: Inliner | None = None,
        location: Node | None = None,
    ) -> list[Node]:
        sub_targets = self._delimiters_re.split(target)

        split_contnode = bool(contnode and contnode.astext() == target)

        in_literal = False
        results = []
        for sub_target in filter(None, sub_targets):
            if split_contnode:
                contnode = nodes.Text(sub_target)

            if in_literal or self._delimiters_re.match(sub_target):
                results.append(contnode or innernode(sub_target, sub_target))  # type: ignore[call-arg]
            else:
                results.append(
                    self.make_xref(
                        rolename,
                        domain,
                        sub_target,
                        innernode,
                        contnode,
                        env,
                        inliner,
                        location,
                    )
                )

            if sub_target in {'Literal', 'typing.Literal', '~typing.Literal'}:
                in_literal = True

        return results


class PyField(PyXrefMixin, Field):
    pass


class PyGroupedField(PyXrefMixin, GroupedField):
    pass


class PyTypedField(PyXrefMixin, TypedField):
    pass

    def get_signature_prefix(self, sig: str) -> Sequence[nodes.Node]:

        * it is added to the full name (return value) if not present

            if prefix:

classname = prefix.rstrip('.')
                fullname = prefix + name

class PyXRefRole(XRefRole):
    def process_link(
        self,
        env: BuildEnvironment,
        refnode: Element,
        has_explicit_title: bool,
        title: str,
        target: str,
    ) -> tuple[str, str]:
        refnode['py:module'] = env.ref_context.get('py:module')
        refnode['py:class'] = env.ref_context.get('py:class')
        if not has_explicit_title:
            title = title.lstrip('.')  # only has a meaning for the target
            target = target.lstrip('~')  # only has a meaning for the title
            # if the first character is a tilde, don't display the module/class
            # parts of the contents
            if title[0:1] == '~':
                title = title[1:]
                dot = title.rfind('.')
                if dot != -1:
                    title = title[dot + 1 :]
        # if the first character is a dot, search more specific namespaces first
        # else search builtins first
        if target[0:1] == '.':
            target = target[1:]

class PythonModuleIndex(Index):
    """Index subclass to provide the Python module index."""

    name = 'modindex'
    localname = _('Python Module Index')
    shortname = _('modules')
    domain: PythonDomain

    def generate(
        self, docnames: Iterable[str] | None = None
    ) -> tuple[list[tuple[str, list[IndexEntry]]], bool]:
        doc_names = frozenset(docnames) if docnames is not None else None

        content: dict[str, list[IndexEntry]] = {}
        # list of prefixes to ignore
        ignores: list[str] = sorted(
            self.domain.env.config['modindex_common_prefix'], key=len, reverse=True
        )

        # list of all modules, sorted by module name
        modules = sorted(self.domain.modules.items(), key=lambda t: t[0].lower())

        # sort out collapsible modules
        prev_modname = ''

        num_top_levels = 0
        for modname, module in modules:
            if doc_names and module.docname not in doc_names:
                continue

            for ignore in ignores:
                if modname.startswith(ignore):
                    modname = modname.removeprefix(ignore)
                    stripped = ignore
                    break
            else:
                stripped = ''

            # we stripped the whole module name?
            if not modname:
                modname, stripped = stripped, ''

            entries = content.setdefault(modname[0].lower(), [])

            package = modname.partition('.')[0]
            if package != modname:
                # it's a submodule
                if prev_modname == package:
                    # first submodule - make parent a group head
                    if entries:
                        last = entries[-1]
                        entries[-1] = IndexEntry(
                            name=last.name,
                            subtype=1,
                            docname=last.docname,
                            anchor=last.anchor,
                            extra=last.extra,
                            qualifier=last.qualifier,
                            descr=last.descr,
                        )
                elif not prev_modname.startswith(package):
                    # submodule without parent in list, add dummy entry
                    dummy_entry = IndexEntry(
                        name=stripped + package,
                        subtype=1,
                        docname='',
                        anchor='',
                        extra='',
                        qualifier='',
                        descr='',
                    )
                    entries.append(dummy_entry)
                subtype = 2
            else:
                num_top_levels += 1
                subtype = 0

            entry = IndexEntry(
                name=stripped + modname,
                subtype=subtype,
                docname=module.docname,
                anchor=module.node_id,
                extra=module.platform,
                qualifier=_('Deprecated') if module.deprecated else '',
                descr=module.synopsis,
            )
            entries.append(entry)
            prev_modname = modname

        # apply heuristics when to collapse modindex at page load:
        # only collapse if number of toplevel modules is larger than
        # number of submodules
        collapse = len(modules) - num_top_levels < num_top_levels

        # sort by first letter
        sorted_content = sorted(content.items())

        return sorted_content, collapse

    name = 'py'

#代码纲要

===/testbed/===
pyproject.toml[9 X G U L]: Role:定义 Sphinx 的 Flit 构建、发行元数据、运行与开发依赖、命令入口及 pytest、覆盖率和类型检查配置 | Uses:README.rst(包说明), LICENSE.rst(许可证), sphinx/cmd/build.py(sphinx-build 入口), sphinx/cmd/quickstart.py(sphinx-quickstart 入口), sphinx/ext/(apidoc 与 autosummary 入口) | API:sphinx-build、sphinx-quickstart、sphinx-apidoc、sphinx-autogen；Sphinx Python 包元数据 | Constraints:要求 Python >=3.11、Docutils >=0.20,<0.23；版本从 sphinx 模块动态获取；Flit sdist 包含文档、测试和工具并排除 doc/_build；pytest 使用严格标记/配置和 xfail_strict，mypy 以 Python 3.11 strict 为基准且测试根有明确例外

===/testbed/doc/extdev/===
envapi.rst[9 O G P E L]: Role:定义扩展可依赖的 BuildEnvironment 全局、逐文档状态及路径、依赖、序号和重读工具接口 | Uses:sphinx/environment/__init__.py(BuildEnvironment), sphinx/project.py(Project), sphinx/config.py(Config), sphinx/events.py(EventManager), sphinx/domains/__init__.py(Domain) | API:BuildEnvironment 及其公开属性和 doc2path、relfn2path、note_dependency、new_serialno、note_reread | Constraints:current_document 只在读取当前文档期间有效；扩展写入映射必须使用唯一前缀；仅列明的 current_document 属性为公开 API，_parser 明确实验性，其类型和其他成员可无通知变更
event_callbacks.rst[9 O G E P L]: Role:定义 Sphinx 核心和构建器事件的顺序、回调参数、返回值及可变对象契约 | Uses:sphinx/events.py(事件管理), sphinx/application.py(connect/emit), sphinx/builders/__init__.py(构建生命周期), sphinx/environment/__init__.py(读取与合并), doc/_static/diagrams/sphinx_core_events_flow.dot(流程图) | API:config-inited、builder-inited、env-get-outdated、env-before-read-docs、env-purge-doc、source-read、include-read、object-description-transform、doctree-read、env-merge-info、env-updated、env-get-updated、env-check-consistency、write-started、doctree-resolved、missing-reference、warn-missing-reference、build-finished、html-collect-pages、html-page-context、linkcheck-process-uri 事件 | Constraints:env-before-read-docs 只能加入 found_docs 且原位改列表；source/include 内容是单元素字符串列表并原位替换；持久环境自定义数据必须在 purge 清理、并行读取时在 merge 合并；write-started 后不得更改 app.parallel_ok；missing-reference 返回替代节点、None 继续处理或抛 NoUri 停止且抑制警告；build-finished 即使异常也触发并在回调后重抛
logging.rst[7 O G E M]: Role:定义扩展获取 Sphinx 日志器、分类定位着色消息以及暂存或加前缀告警的公开接口 | Uses:sphinx/util/logging.py(日志实现), sphinx/config.py(suppress_warnings) | API:getLogger、SphinxLoggerAdapter、pending_logging、pending_warnings、prefixed_warnings | Constraints:告警 type/subtype 用于 suppress_warnings 匹配；location 可为文档名、文档名与行号元组或节点；nonl 仅适用于普通日志以禁止末尾换行折叠
projectapi.rst[5 O G T]: Role:公开 Project 对源文件发现、文档名与路径转换及源后缀管理的接口参考 | Uses:sphinx/project.py(Project 实现) | API:Project | Constraints:-

===/testbed/doc/usage/===
configuration.rst[9 O G I J V L]: Role:作为 conf.py 权威参考定义项目、解析、国际化、标记、模板、告警及各 HTML/EPUB/LaTeX/文本/man/Texinfo/QtHelp/XML/linkcheck/领域构建配置 | Uses:sphinx/config.py(配置装载与校验), sphinx/application.py(扩展和 Tags), sphinx/builders/(各输出配置消费者), sphinx/domains/(领域配置消费者), sphinx/search/(HTML 搜索配置) | API:conf.py 构建配置文件与 tags 对象；本文列出的 project/author/version/release、extensions、source、markup、i18n、HTML、EPUB、LaTeX、text、man、Texinfo、QtHelp、XML、linkcheck、C/C++/JavaScript/Python 领域配置值 | Constraints:conf.py 在配置目录为当前目录执行任意 Python，简单名称进入配置且命名空间须可 pickle，模块会自动移除；文档名统一 / 且无后缀，普通 glob 不跨 / 而 ** 可跨；构建器名/格式标签在 conf.py 执行时尚不可用；扩展必须可导入且修改 sys.path 使用绝对路径；exclude_patterns 优先 include_patterns并也约束 HTML 静态/附加复制；source_suffix 扩展名须以点开头，非 UTF-8 源编码已弃用并将在 Sphinx 10 移除；docutils.conf 禁用 smartquotes 无条件生效而启用仍受 Sphinx 配置控制，多目标 make 只用首目标判断排除且缓存可能需 -E；模板与主题相对配置目录，静态文件后复制可覆盖主题但默认不复制点文件，extra 会复制点文件并覆盖同名输出；html_sidebars 值必须为字符串列表且多 glob 命中告警，singlehtml 仅接受 index 键；OpenSearch 基址不得尾斜杠；Apple Help 必须设置 bundle_id且外部工具只在 macOS 可完成有效 help book；EPUB 必需 Dublin Core 元数据，uid 首字符不能是连字符、句点或数字，自动图像修复可能丢信息；LaTeX title/author 是原生标记且需转义，额外 .tex 会被 latexpdf 自动编译，Unicode 数学应使用 Xe/LuaLaTeX 加 unicode-math，howto 忽略 appendices；linkcheck 正则整串匹配语义依配置而定，认证取首个匹配，401 默认 broken，超时默认 timeout，限流尊重 Retry-After否则指数退避至上限；领域专属签名长度覆盖全局值，Python 类型参数与参数列表分别计算长度；配置默认值与允许类型以本文各 confval 为准

===/testbed/sphinx/===
__init__.py[9 C G V T]: Role:定义 Sphinx 包版本、显示版本、版本元组与包目录，并在开发源码树中尝试附加 Git 短提交标识 | Uses:sphinx/util/_pathlib.py(包路径类型) | API:__version__、__display_version__、version_info、package_dir | Constraints:version_info 固定为五元组且阶段仅为 alpha/beta/rc/final；开发标识查询失败不得阻止导入，显示版本与发布版本可不同
__main__.py[8 E G T]: Role:作为 python -m sphinx 入口把命令行参数交给构建命令并以其返回值退出 | Uses:sphinx/cmd/build.py(main 构建入口) | API:python -m sphinx | Constraints:必须传递 sys.argv[1:] 并用 SystemExit 保留 CLI 状态码
application.py[9 C G E P L]: Role:实现 Sphinx 主应用，协调目录校验、配置与扩展装载、事件、项目和环境恢复、构建器生命周期、状态汇报及全部扩展注册 API | Uses:sphinx/config.py(配置装载), sphinx/environment/__init__.py(持久环境), sphinx/registry.py(组件注册与扩展装载), sphinx/events.py(事件分发), sphinx/builders/__init__.py(构建执行) | API:Sphinx、TemplateBridge；setup_extension、require_sphinx、connect/disconnect/emit/emit_firstresult；add_builder/add_config_value/add_event/set_translator/add_node/add_enumerable_node/add_directive/add_role/add_generic_role/add_domain/add_directive_to_domain/add_role_to_domain/add_index_to_domain/add_object_type/add_crossref_type/add_transform/add_post_transform/add_js_file/add_css_file/add_latex_package/add_lexer/add_autodocumenter/add_autodoc_attrgetter/add_search_language/add_source_suffix/add_source_parser/add_env_collector/add_html_theme/add_html_math_renderer/add_message_catalog、set_html_assets_policy | Constraints:源目录必须存在，源与输出目录不得相同；内置及用户扩展须在 config-inited 前装载，构建器预载后才最终创建；环境缓存反序列化或版本失败则新建，构建异常删除 environment.pickle 并仍发 build-finished(error) 后重抛；fail-on-warning 完整构建后把状态设 1，exception-on-warning 则逐条抛异常；扩展未明确并行安全或明确不安全时对应阶段退回串行；注册同名组件是否覆盖由各 API 的 override 契约决定，Docutils 节点/指令/角色还须同步全局注册；JS/CSS 默认优先级为 500并在 builder 已存在时同时注入当前 builder；HTML 资产策略只接受 always/per_page。必须保持未知事件、重复事件、监听器断开和返回列表语义（test_application.py::test_events）；必须保持未声明或 false 并行元数据分别告警并回退串行（test_application.py::test_add_is_parallel_allowed）
config.py[9 C G E V L]: Role:执行并抽象 conf.py，注册和延迟解析配置值，处理命令行覆盖、类型校验、缓存序列化、兼容转换及 config-inited 规范化 | Uses:sphinx/application.py(配置事件接线), sphinx/errors.py(配置与扩展错误), sphinx/util/tags.py(conf.py tags), sphinx/deprecation.py(兼容警告) | API:Config、ConfigValue、ENUM、is_serializable、eval_config_file、check_confval_types；扩展 setup(app) | Constraints:conf.py 在配置目录作为当前目录执行，语法、sys.exit 和任意执行异常均包装为 ConfigError（已有 ConfigError 原样传播）；覆盖优先于 conf.py，点号键写入字典子键，列表以逗号拆分，布尔只接受 0/1，字典整体覆盖被忽略并告警；配置默认值可调用且延迟求值，root_doc/master_doc 与 copyright/project_copyright 赋值双向同步；缓存只保存可序列化公开值和重建标记，含函数/类/模块的重建配置告警并写 None；扩展配置名不可重复；source_suffix 兼容 str/list 并规范成映射，旧 highlight_options 规范成按语言映射；language=None 兼容回退 en 并告警，非 UTF-8 源编码发弃用告警；numfig_format 在默认本地化标签上合并用户值；SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH 仅把合法开头当前年份或区间末年回退至可重现年份。必须保持循环容器可序列化并可 pickle、不同协议恢复等价（test_config_pickle_*）；必须保持 ENUM/显式类型告警、Any 放行及 list→tuple/frozenset 规范化（test_check_types 等）；必须保持 -D 的布尔/字符串联合类型与无效纯布尔异常语义（test_*_command_line、test_boolean_command_line_invalid）
deprecation.py[7 C G V T]: Role:提供 Sphinx 9/10 弃用警告类别与模块级弃用别名的统一诊断辅助函数 | Uses:- | API:RemovedInSphinx90Warning、RemovedInSphinx10Warning、RemovedInNextVersionWarning | Constraints:仅接受移除版本 (9,0) 或 (10,0)，其他值抛 RuntimeError；raises=True 改抛 AttributeError；未设置 PYTHONWARNINGS 时默认显示下一版本弃用告警，替代路径存在时消息必须给出 canonical name
errors.py[8 C G T]: Role:定义 Sphinx 可友好展示的错误层次以及并行、源码分析、无 URI 和未知文件类型等专用异常 | Uses:- | API:SphinxError、SphinxWarning、ApplicationError、ExtensionError、BuildEnvironmentError、ConfigError、DocumentError、ThemeError、VersionRequirementError、SphinxParallelError、PycodeError、NoUri、FiletypeNotFoundError | Constraints:SphinxError 子类由 CLI 以 category 与消息友好呈现，非其子类视为意外异常；ExtensionError 须保留原异常和模块名并把原异常附加到字符串；SphinxParallelError 字符串只返回消息并另存 traceback。必须保持 ExtensionError 在有无原异常时的 repr 精确形态（test_extension_error_repr、test_extension_error_with_orig_exc_repr）
events.py[9 C G E M]: Role:定义核心事件表并按优先级管理监听器的注册、断开、广播及首个非 None 结果 | Uses:sphinx/errors.py(事件与扩展错误), sphinx/util/inspect.py(安全识别回调模块) | API:EventManager、EventListener、core_events；add、connect、disconnect、emit、emit_firstresult | Constraints:未知事件连接和重复自定义事件均抛 ExtensionError；监听器 ID 单调递增，emit 按 priority 升序且同优先级保持注册顺序；回调总先接收 app，emit 返回所有结果，emit_firstresult 返回首个非 None；allowed_exceptions 与 SphinxError 原样传播，其他异常包装为带 handler/event/module 的 ExtensionError，但 pdb 模式原样重抛。必须保持优先级顺序 [3,1,2,5,4] 及 RuntimeError 仅在 allowed_exceptions 或 pdb 下透传（tests/test_events.py）
extension.py[8 C G E T]: Role:保存已加载扩展的元数据并在配置初始化时校验 needs_extensions 的装载与最低版本要求 | Uses:sphinx/application.py(扩展集合与事件), sphinx/config.py(needs_extensions), sphinx/errors.py(版本错误), sphinx/util/logging.py(诊断) | API:Extension、verify_needs_extensions、setup | Constraints:未声明 parallel_read_safe 为 None，parallel_write_safe 默认 True；缺失必需扩展只告警，未知版本或低于要求则抛 VersionRequirementError；优先按 packaging Version 比较，无效版本退回字符串比较。必须保持 3.10 满足 3.9 而不满足 3.11（test_needs_extensions）
io.py[5 C G V S]: Role:保留已弃用的 Sphinx Docutils reader、writer 与输入适配层，替换转换器和 reporter 并发出 source-read 事件 | Uses:sphinx/transforms/__init__.py(SphinxTransformer), sphinx/environment/__init__.py(source-read 环境事件), sphinx/util/docutils.py(LoggingReporter), sphinx/deprecation.py(弃用告警) | API:SphinxBaseReader、SphinxStandaloneReader、SphinxDummyWriter、SphinxDummySourceClass、SphinxFileInput | Constraints:导入模块及实例化各适配器均发 Sphinx 10 弃用告警；reader 移除 DanglingReferences、安装 SphinxTransformer 与 LoggingReporter；source-read 接收可原位替换的单元素内容列表；FileInput 固定使用 sphinx 错误处理器
project.py[8 C G S]: Role:发现项目源文档并维护文档名与源目录相对路径的双向转换 | Uses:sphinx/util/matching.py(路径匹配), sphinx/util/osutil.py(文档名规范化) | API:Project；discover、path2doc、doc2path | Constraints:发现时应用 include、用户 exclude 和内置 _sources/编辑器临时文件/.lproj 排除；同一 docname 多后缀只采用首个可读匹配并告警， unreadable 文件告警跳过；文档名去除匹配后缀并统一路径；未知 docname 的 doc2path 为兼容性拼接首个 source_suffix。必须保持多后缀、复合后缀、模板目录排除及绝对/相对路径转换结果（tests/test_project.py）

#====项目纲要====
#【部署】Python 3.11+ 库与命令行工具，使用 Flit 构建；pip 安装后提供 sphinx-build、sphinx-quickstart、sphinx-apidoc、sphinx-autogen；开发检查以 tox/pytest、ruff、mypy 及 npm/Jasmine 为主，文档用 sphinx-build -M html ./doc ./build/sphinx --fail-on-warning 构建
#【系统】Sphinx 是以 Docutils 文档树为中间表示、由可扩展 Python 应用协调配置、解析、环境缓存、交叉引用、构建器与写出器，生成 HTML/LaTeX/EPUB/文本等格式的文档生成系统 | CLI→Sphinx 应用→配置/注册表/事件→BuildEnvironment→Builder/Transforms→Writer/模板与静态资产 | 必须保持扩展 API、事件生命周期、配置兼容、增量环境与各输出格式的公开契约
#【架构】入口层解析命令及构建模式；核心层由 application/config/events/registry/project/environment 协调；解析与领域层把 reStructuredText 及扩展语法转为 Docutils/Sphinx 节点并解析引用；构建器与写出器按目标格式处理节点；扩展层通过 setup(app) 注册事件、指令、角色、领域、构建器和资源；主题/模板/搜索/本地化提供展示与语言资源；testing 与 tests 提供集成夹具及契约验证
#【数据流】命令行参数与 conf.py→Config/Tags/扩展装载→Project 发现源文件→BuildEnvironment 读取并缓存 doctree/索引/依赖→Transforms 与引用解析→Builder 选择待写文档并调用 Writer/模板→目标目录；异常与警告经日志、事件和 CLI 状态码反馈
#【顶层约束】源码目录与输出目录不得相同；扩展依赖必须经应用注册机制装载；构建失败会移除环境缓存以强制后续全量环境；并行读取/写出仅在全部扩展明确声明安全时启用；新增行为需相应测试和文档，非平凡或行为变更需更新 CHANGES.rst；翻译源 .po 更新后须同步编译 .mo 与 .js
#【整体规范】
#纲要格式：文件名[标签]: Role:职责 | Uses:依赖 | API:对外契约 | Constraints:约束 ；文件名不带路径；四字段必填,无内容写-
#骨架规则：只有裸文件名没有纲要的行是尚未建立认知的文件,读取时顺便生成纲要并调用 ortg_update 提交
#目标规则：条目下一行 #目标: 是目标纲要(改完后应有的纲要,不写待核查事项)；#目标:删除 计划删除；#计划新建 文件尚不存在
#测试契约规则：被测试锁定的对外行为写成"必须保持 X(测试名)"并写清期望结果；只涉及一个文件的写进它的 Constraints,跨模块的登记进【契约】；需求与守护测试冲突时按证据裁决:需求点名该测试或说旧行为错→改测试,需求说测试权威/行为不变/只是迁移→保持,有命令与期望输出的验收例→按实跑结果,都没有→先求两全,不能两全按需求实现,并把选择与理由记进纲要
#契约规则：跨模块、不靠调用关系的约定(同一概念由多层共同实现、协议与消息格式、单位、兼容性、HTTP/WebSocket 路由与消息类型、配置键)在纲要头登记一行 #【契约】键：正文(正文写约定与守护测试,只写这一处)；每个参与文件在纲要行末尾加 | Keys:键(角色),… 声明它；路由、消息、事件、配置、环境变量类的键写成 route:/ws:/msg:/event:/topic:/cfg:/env: 加字面值
#===代码纲要规范===
#【标签】[C A B D… E] 重要度数字在前,其后层级、模块、特征(0到多个)、规模,空格分隔,每个是一个大写字母(模块可两个)
#A层级: E入口 C核心 S服务 D数据 I集成 U工具 T测试 B构建 X配置 O文档
#B模块: G核心通用 B构建写出 D领域语法 X扩展 H网页主题搜索 L本地化 T测试夹具 P项目文档 U开发工具
#C重要度: 9核心 8高频 7业务 5常规 3辅助 1边缘
#D特征: E事件扩展 I国际化 J模板前端 P并行缓存 V版本兼容
#E规模: L大>400 M中200-400 S小100-200 T微<100
#Constraints配额: C9≤2000字 C8≤1200字 C7-4≤500字 C3-1≤100字
#===代码纲要规范完毕===

   150	    def __init__(self, buffers: list[str]) -> None:
   151	        lines = iter(buffers)
   152	        self.buffers = buffers
   153	        self.tokens = tokenize.generate_tokens(lambda: next(lines))
   154	        self.current: Token | None = None

   158	        """Returns specified line."""

   161	    def fetch_token(self) -> Token | None:
   162	        """Fetch the next token from source code.
   163	
   164	        Returns ``None`` if sequence finished.
   165	        """
   166	        try:
   167	            self.previous = self.current
   168	            self.current = Token(*next(self.tokens))
   169	        except StopIteration:
   170	            self.current = None
   171	
   172	        return self.current

   174	    def fetch_until(self, condition: Any) -> list[Token]:
   175	        """Fetch tokens until specified token appeared.
   176	
   177	        .. note:: This also handles parenthesis well.
   178	        """
   179	        tokens = []
   180	        while current := self.fetch_token():
   181	            tokens.append(current)
   182	            if current == condition:
   183	                break
   184	            if current == [OP, '(']:
   185	                tokens += self.fetch_until([OP, ')'])
   186	            elif current == [OP, '{']:
   187	                tokens += self.fetch_until([OP, '}'])
   188	            elif current == [OP, '[']:
   189	                tokens += self.fetch_until([OP, ']'])

   191	        return tokens

   194	class AfterCommentParser(TokenProcessor):
   195	    """Python source code parser to pick up comments after assignments.
   196	
   197	    This parser takes code which starts with an assignment statement,
   198	    and returns the comment for the variable if one exists.
   199	    """

   201	    def __init__(self, lines: list[str]) -> None:
   202	        super().__init__(lines)
   203	        self.comment: str | None = None

   205	    def fetch_rvalue(self) -> list[Token]:
   206	        """Fetch right-hand value of assignment."""
   207	        tokens = []
   208	        while current := self.fetch_token():
   209	            tokens.append(current)
   210	            if current == [OP, '(']:
   211	                tokens += self.fetch_until([OP, ')'])
   212	            elif current == [OP, '{']:
   213	                tokens += self.fetch_until([OP, '}'])
   214	            elif current == [OP, '[']:
   215	                tokens += self.fetch_until([OP, ']'])
   216	            elif current == INDENT:
   217	                tokens += self.fetch_until(DEDENT)
   218	            elif current == [OP, ';']:  # NoQA: SIM114
   219	                break
   220	            elif current and current.kind not in {OP, NAME, NUMBER, STRING}:
   221	                break
   222	
   223	        return tokens
   224	
   225	    def parse(self) -> None:
   226	        """Parse the code and obtain comment after assignment."""
   227	        # skip lvalue (or whole of AnnAssign)
   228	        while (tok := self.fetch_token()) and not tok.match(
   229	            [OP, '='], NEWLINE, COMMENT
   230	        ):
   231	            assert tok
   232	        assert tok is not None
   233	
   234	        # skip rvalue (if exists)
   235	        if tok == [OP, '=']:
   236	            self.fetch_rvalue()
   237	            tok = self.current
   238	            assert tok is not None
   239	
   240	        if tok == COMMENT:
   241	            self.comment = tok.value

   244	class VariableCommentPicker(ast.NodeVisitor):
   245	    """Python source code parser to pick up variable comments."""

   247	    def __init__(self, buffers: list[str], encoding: str) -> None:

   265	    def get_qualname_for(self, name: str) -> list[str] | None:

   520	class DefinitionFinder(TokenProcessor):
   521	    """Python source code parser to detect location of functions,
   522	    classes and methods.
   523	    """
   524	
   525	    def __init__(self, lines: list[str]) -> None:
   526	        super().__init__(lines)
   527	        self.decorator: Token | None = None
   528	        self.context: list[str] = []
   529	        self.indents: list[tuple[str, str | None, int | None]] = []
   530	        self.definitions: dict[str, tuple[str, int, int]] = {}
   531	
   532	    def add_definition(self, name: str, entry: tuple[str, int, int]) -> None:
   533	        """Add a location of definition."""
   534	        if self.indents and self.indents[-1][0] == entry[0] == 'def':
   535	            # ignore definition of inner function
   536	            pass
   537	        else:
   538	            self.definitions[name] = entry
   539	
   540	    def parse(self) -> None:
   541	        """Parse the code to obtain location of definitions."""
   542	        while True:
   543	            token = self.fetch_token()
   544	            if token is None:
   545	                break
   546	            if token == COMMENT:
   547	                pass
   548	            elif token == [OP, '@'] and (
   549	                self.previous is None
   550	                or self.previous.match(NEWLINE, NL, INDENT, DEDENT)
   551	            ):
   552	                if self.decorator is None:
   553	                    self.decorator = token
   554	            elif token.match([NAME, 'class']):
   555	                self.parse_definition('class')
   556	            elif token.match([NAME, 'def']):
   557	                self.parse_definition('def')
   558	            elif token == INDENT:
   559	                self.indents.append(('other', None, None))
   560	            elif token == DEDENT:
   561	                self.finalize_block()
   562	
   563	    def parse_definition(self, typ: str) -> None:
   564	        """Parse AST of definition."""
   565	        name = self.fetch_token()
   566	        self.context.append(name.value)  # type: ignore[union-attr]
   567	        funcname = '.'.join(self.context)
   568	
   569	        if self.decorator:
   570	            start_pos = self.decorator.start[0]
   571	            self.decorator = None
   572	        else:
   573	            start_pos = name.start[0]  # type: ignore[union-attr]
   574	
   575	        self.fetch_until([OP, ':'])
   576	        if self.fetch_token().match(COMMENT, NEWLINE):  # type: ignore[union-attr]
   577	            self.fetch_until(INDENT)
   578	            self.indents.append((typ, funcname, start_pos))
   579	        else:
   580	            # one-liner
   581	            self.add_definition(funcname, (typ, start_pos, name.end[0]))  # type: ignore[union-attr]
   582	            self.context.pop()

   584	    def finalize_block(self) -> None:
   585	        """Finalize definition block."""
   586	        definition = self.indents.pop()
   587	        if definition[0] != 'other':
   588	            typ, funcname, start_pos = definition
   589	            end_pos = self.current.end[0] - 1  # type: ignore[union-attr]
   590	            while emptyline_re.match(self.get_line(end_pos)):
   591	                end_pos -= 1
   592	
   593	            self.add_definition(funcname, (typ, start_pos, end_pos))  # type: ignore[arg-type]
   594	            self.context.pop()

   598	    """Python source code parser to pick up variable comments.
   599	
   600	    This is a better wrapper for ``VariableCommentPicker``.
   601	    """

   603	    def __init__(self, code: str, encoding: str = 'utf-8') -> None:
   604	        self.code = filter_whitespace(code)
   605	        self.encoding = encoding
   606	        self.annotations: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {}
   607	        self.comments: dict[tuple[str, str], str] = {}

   616	        self.parse_definition()

   618	    def parse_comments(self) -> None:
   619	        """Parse the code and pick up comments."""
   620	        tree = ast.parse(self.code, type_comments=True)
   621	        picker = VariableCommentPicker(self.code.splitlines(True), self.encoding)
   622	        picker.visit(tree)
   623	        self.annotations = picker.annotations
   624	        self.comments = picker.comments
   625	        self.deforders = picker.deforders
   626	        self.finals = picker.finals
   627	        self.overloads = picker.overloads

   630	        """Parse the location of definitions from the code."""
   631	        parser = DefinitionFinder(self.code.splitlines(True))

   329	            not isinstance(frozen, dict)

   366	    def get_objects(
   367	        self, fn2index: dict[str, int]
   368	    ) -> dict[str, list[tuple[int, int, int, str, str]]]:
   369	        rv: dict[str, list[tuple[int, int, int, str, str]]] = {}
   370	        otypes = self._objtypes
   371	        onames = self._objnames
   372	        for domain in self._domains.sorted():
   373	            sorted_objects = sorted(domain.get_objects())
   374	            for fullname, dispname, type, docname, anchor, prio in sorted_objects:
   375	                if docname not in fn2index:
   376	                    continue
   377	                if prio < 0:
   378	                    continue
   379	                fullname = html.escape(fullname)
   380	                dispname = html.escape(dispname)
   381	                prefix, _, name = dispname.rpartition('.')
   382	                plist = rv.setdefault(prefix, [])
   383	                try:
   384	                    typeindex = otypes[domain.name, type]
   385	                except KeyError:
   386	                    typeindex = len(otypes)
   387	                    otypes[domain.name, type] = typeindex
   388	                    otype = domain.object_types.get(type)
   389	                    if otype:
   390	                        # use str() to fire translation proxies
   391	                        onames[typeindex] = (
   392	                            domain.name,
   393	                            type,
   394	                            str(domain.get_type_name(otype)),
   395	                        )
   396	                    else:
   397	                        onames[typeindex] = (domain.name, type, type)
   398	                if anchor == fullname:
   399	                    shortanchor = ''
   400	                elif anchor == type + '-' + fullname:
   401	                    shortanchor = '-'
   402	                else:

   407	    def get_terms(
   408	        self, fn2index: dict[str, int]
   409	    ) -> tuple[dict[str, list[int] | int], dict[str, list[int] | int]]:
   410	        """Return a mapping of document and title terms to sorted document IDs.
   411	
   412	        When a term is only found within a single document,
   413	        then the value for that term will be an integer value.
   414	        When a term is found within multiple documents,
   415	        the value will be a list of integers.
   416	        """
   417	        rvs: tuple[dict[str, list[int] | int], dict[str, list[int] | int]] = ({}, {})
   418	        for rv, mapping in zip(rvs, (self._mapping, self._title_mapping), strict=True):
   419	            for k, v in mapping.items():
   420	                if len(v) == 1:
   421	                    (fn,) = v
   422	                    if fn in fn2index:
   423	                        rv[k] = fn2index[fn]
   424	                else:
   425	                    rv[k] = sorted(fn2index[fn] for fn in v if fn in fn2index)

   428	    def freeze(self) -> dict[str, Any]:

   430	        docnames, titles = zip(*sorted(self._titles.items()), strict=True)
   431	        filenames = [self._filenames.get(docname) for docname in docnames]
   432	        fn2index = {f: i for (i, f) in enumerate(docnames)}
   433	        terms, title_terms = self.get_terms(fn2index)
   434	
   435	        objects = self.get_objects(fn2index)  # populates _objtypes
   436	        objtypes = {v: k[0] + ':' + k[1] for (k, v) in self._objtypes.items()}
   437	        objnames = self._objnames
   438	
   439	        alltitles: dict[str, list[tuple[int, str | None]]] = {}
   440	        for docname, titlelist in sorted(self._all_titles.items()):
   441	            for title, titleid in titlelist:
   442	                alltitles.setdefault(title, []).append((fn2index[docname], titleid))
   443	
   444	        index_entries: dict[str, list[tuple[int, str, bool]]] = {}
   445	        for docname, entries in self._index_entries.items():
   446	            for entry, entry_id, main_entry in entries:
   447	                index_entries.setdefault(entry.lower(), []).append((
   448	                    fn2index[docname],
   449	                    entry_id,
   450	                    main_entry == 'main',

   453	        return {
   454	            'docnames': docnames,
   455	            'filenames': filenames,
   456	            'titles': titles,
   457	            'terms': terms,
   458	            'objects': objects,

   460	            'objnames': objnames,

   481	        self._filenames = new_filenames
   482	        self._all_titles = new_alltitles

   488	    def feed(
   489	        self,

   492	        title: str,
   493	        doctree: nodes.document,
   494	    ) -> None:
   495	        """Feed a doctree to the index."""

   497	        self._filenames[docname] = os.fspath(filename)

   499	        word_store = self._word_collector(doctree)

   503	
   504	        # memoise self.lang.stem
   505	        @functools.cache
   506	        def stem(word_to_stem: str) -> str:
   507	            return _stem(word_to_stem).lower()
